title: Data Analysis & Bivariate Data
preview: Scatter plots, line-of-fit modeling, identifying association and outliers, and two-way tables for categorical data.
description: Students build scatter plots, fit lines by eye, distinguish association from no-association cases, and reason about two-way tables using joint, row, and column percentages.

sections.label: 10-1 Scatter Plots & Association
sections.description: Construct scatter plots; identify positive/negative/no association.

sections.label: 10-2 Lines of Best Fit
sections.description: Draw a line of fit by eye; use it to predict.

sections.label: 10-3 No Association
sections.description: Recognise when two variables are NOT meaningfully related.

sections.label: 10-4 Two-Way Tables (Categorical Bivariate Data)
sections.description: Joint, row, and column relative frequencies; detect association. (Not an Indiana grade-8 standard — CCSS 8.SP.4 topic; no standard mapping.)
